subject: 970 Fellsway 40B Development Design Review
overview: The Board held a focused session on the architectural design and massing of a proposed 289-unit residential development at 970 Fellsway. Members requested further articulation of the facades and more detailed site programming before continuing the matter to a session on civil engineering.

items.title: 970 Fellsway (Case 40B-2023-01)
items.summary: The applicant presented conceptual designs, floor plans, and shadow studies for a six-story apartment building and 11 townhomes designed to Passive House standards. The Board and peer reviewers requested additional strategies to break up the building's scale on Amaranth Avenue and more detail regarding rooftop mechanical screening and ground-floor activation; the matter was continued to April 11.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Zoning Consultant Report
items.summary: Staff provided updates on upcoming clerk absences and invited board members to meet with the city's zoning consultant to discuss administrative improvements to the zoning code.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for January 30, 2024, and March 14, 2024.
